stories.headline: SK Hynix posts record Q2 but misses estimates, triggering a fresh chip selloff

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix reported Q2 2026 revenue of 79.3187 trillion won, operating profit of 60.5426 trillion won (a 76% operating margin) and net profit of 93.9226 trillion won, an all-time quarterly high announced in Seoul on July 29, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: SK hynix Inc. announced today that it has recorded 79.3187 trillion won in revenues, 60.5426 trillion won in operating profit (with an operating margin of 76%), and 93.9226 trillion won in net profit (with a net margin of 118%), marking an all-time high quarterly performance.

key_facts.fact: Revenue rose 257% and operating profit 557% year over year, against Q2 2025 revenue of 22.232 trillion won and operating profit of 9.2129 trillion won; first-half revenue crossed 100 trillion won for the first time.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue and operating profit increased by 257% and 557% year-over-year, respectively. * Q2 2025: Revenue of 22.232 trillion won, Operating Profit of 9.2129 trillion won

key_facts.fact: Both headline numbers came in below consensus — roughly $54.34B of revenue versus about $57.56B expected, and about $41.48B of operating profit versus about $43.85B expected — and the shares nosedived on Wednesday.
key_facts.excerpt: SK Hynix reports Q2 revenue up 257% YoY to ~$54.34B, below ~$57.56B est., and operating profit up 557% YoY to ~$41.48B, below ~$43.85B est. … SK Hynix shares nosedived on Wednesday as exponential second-quarter earnings and revenue growth still failed to satisfy analysts' supercharged expectations

key_facts.fact: The miss spilled into the wider chip complex on Wednesday, with Sandisk down more than 7.5%, Arm more than 6.5% and AMD more than 6.5%.
key_facts.excerpt: Investors continue to dump chipmaker stocks on Wednesday following disappointing results from SK Hynix; Sandisk is down 7.5%+, Arm 6.5%+, and AMD 6.5%+

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix began mass shipments of HBM4 in the second quarter and will ramp production in the second half; HBM4E samples shipped in the first half.
key_facts.excerpt: The company began mass shipments of HBM4 in the second quarter and will ramp up production in the second half of the year. For HBM4E, which completed sample shipments in the first half, the company applied optimal processes…

key_facts.fact: The company has finalized long-term supply agreements with around 10 customers and ended the quarter with 88 trillion won in cash, up 33.6 trillion won quarter over quarter, for a net cash position of 69.4 trillion won.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has finalized Long-Term Agreements (LTAs) with around 10 customers … cash and cash equivalents reached 88 trillion won at the end of the second quarter, an increase of 33.6 trillion won from the previous quarter … expanding the net cash position to 69.4 trillion won.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix said it is accelerating M15X mass production and preparing the Yongin Phase 1 cleanroom for early 2027, alongside the P&T7 advanced packaging plant and M17 NAND base, while pledging capex discipline.
key_facts.excerpt: SK hynix is accelerating the mass production schedule for M15X while making investments to rapidly expand production capacity following the opening of the Yongin Phase 1 cleanroom in early 2027. Mid-to-long-term investment plans—including the recently announced P&T7 advanced packaging facility, M17 NAND production base…

stories.headline: Brookfield and NextEra to build a $100B AI data center campus on a DOE uranium site in Kentucky

key_facts.fact: A coalition announced on July 29, 2026 a $100 billion privately funded data center campus at the US Department of Energy's Paducah Site in western Kentucky, on land from the former uranium enrichment plant.
key_facts.excerpt: PADUCAH, Ky., July 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- A coalition of energy, infrastructure and utility companies today announced a strategic partnership to develop a data center campus at the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Paducah Site in Western Kentucky. The $100 billion privately-funded project repurposes land at the former enrichment site into a hub for innovation and energy generation.

key_facts.fact: Once fully built in 2032, the campus will support up to 1.8 GW of utility capacity and over 1.2 GW of compute capacity, backed by up to 4.6 GW of dedicated generation built specifically for the project.
key_facts.excerpt: Once fully constructed in 2032, the campus will support up to 1.8 gigawatts (GW) of utility capacity and over 1.2 GW of compute capacity — backed by up to 4.6 GW of dedicated generation resources paid for and built specifically for the project, protecting customers from costs and fulfilling President Trump's Ratepayer Protection Pledge.

key_facts.fact: The coalition is Brookfield, NextEra Energy, Big Rivers Electric Power Corporation, Jackson Purchase Energy Cooperative and Paducah Power System; the project is expected to create about 8,000 construction jobs and 600 full-time operations jobs.
key_facts.excerpt: The partnership coalition includes Brookfield, NextEra Energy, Big Rivers Electric Power Corporation, Jackson Purchase Energy Cooperative and Paducah Power System. … The development is expected to create approximately 8,000 construction jobs and 600 full-time operations jobs.

key_facts.fact: Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the project provides 'a crucial roadmap for future projects' by showing infrastructure can be built without passing costs to surrounding communities.
key_facts.excerpt: "It's difficult to overestimate the importance of this project. The planning and investment by NextEra Energy and Brookfield provides a crucial roadmap for future projects in the United States by revealing the ability to build world leading infrastructure without passing costs on to surrounding communities."

key_facts.fact: NextEra plans to build as much as 2 GW of natural gas capacity paired with up to 2.6 GW of battery storage, while Brookfield will own and operate the data center campus itself.
key_facts.excerpt: The campus is expected to support up to 1.8 gigawatts of utility capacity and over 1.2 gigawatts of compute capacity, with NextEra building as much as 2 gigawatts of natural gas capacity paired with up to 2.6 gigawatts of battery storage, while Brookfield will own and operate the data center campus.

key_facts.fact: Brookfield and NextEra frame the site as a 'bring your own power' model built at the DOE's Paducah location, one of the largest US AI infrastructure projects announced to date.
key_facts.excerpt: Brookfield and NextEra partner to develop a $100B, 1.2GW+ AI data center campus at a former DOE uranium-enrichment site in Kentucky, set to open in 2032. The companies plan to develop a data center campus on the Energy Department's Paducah site in western Kentucky

stories.headline: FCC bans imports of foreign humanoid robots and power inverters, adding them to its Covered List

key_facts.fact: FCC chairman Brendan Carr announced on July 28, 2026 that the agency added two new device categories to its Covered List, banning new versions from import or sale in the US.
key_facts.excerpt: NEW — The FCC has now added two new categories of devices to our Covered List, which bans new versions from import or sale in America.

key_facts.fact: The categories are advanced robotic devices such as humanoids and quadrupeds produced in foreign countries, and power inverters produced in foreign countries.
key_facts.excerpt: 1. Advanced robotic devices, such as humanoids and quadrupeds produced in foreign countries. 2. Power inverters produced in foreign countries.

key_facts.fact: The action follows determinations by executive-branch national security agencies that the devices pose unacceptable risks, and includes exemptions for devices cleared by a Defense or Homeland Security finding.
key_facts.excerpt: This action follows determinations by Executive Branch nat sec agencies that the devices pose unacceptable risks to our national security. It includes exemptions for devices that, based on a DOW or DHS finding, pose no unacceptable threat.

key_facts.fact: The bans specifically target Chinese robots and inverters and are framed as protecting the US AI buildout and reshoring key industries.
key_facts.excerpt: The US FCC bans importing Chinese humanoid robots and power inverters to protect the US AI buildout from national security threats and to reshore key industries. The Trump administration on Tuesday unveiled bans that target imports of new Chinese robots and power inverters

stories.headline: GlobalFoundries signs a $300M CHIPS R&D deal for silicon photonics, US takes ~1% stake

key_facts.fact: GlobalFoundries said the US plans to award it $300 million in CHIPS Act funding to bolster R&D of silicon photonics technology for more efficient AI data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: GlobalFoundries says the US plans to award it $300M in CHIPS Act funding to bolster R&D of silicon photonics tech to power more efficient AI data centers

key_facts.fact: The company signed a letter of intent with the US Department of Commerce for the award, routed through the CHIPS Research & Development Office and covering silicon photonics, optical materials, wafer technologies and advanced packaging.
key_facts.excerpt: GlobalFoundries (Nasdaq: $GFS) has signed a Letter of Intent with the U.S. Department of Commerce for a potential $300 million CHIPS Research & Development Office (CRDO) award … $300M expected CHIPS R&D award focused on silicon photonics, optical materials, wafer technologies and advanced packaging.

key_facts.fact: The roadmap targets 400Gb/s optical performance and up to 5x higher energy efficiency versus current solutions, supporting near-packaged and co-packaged optics for AI infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: Technology roadmap aims for 400Gb/s optical performance and up to 5x higher energy efficiency compared with current solutions. Supports emerging architectures including near-packaged optics (NPO) and co-packaged optics (CPO) for AI infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: A separate agreement gives the US government roughly a 1% ownership stake in GlobalFoundries, and the work leans on the company's existing US sites in Malta, New York and Burlington, Vermont.
key_facts.excerpt: Separate agreement gives the U.S. government approximately 1% ownership stake in GlobalFoundries … Leverages existing U.S. manufacturing sites in Malta, New York and Burlington, Vermont to develop high-volume silicon photonics production capabilities.

key_facts.fact: The Commerce Department's letter of intent takes about a 1% equity stake and funds the 400G generation of photonics wafer technology and packaging for co-packaged optics.
key_facts.excerpt: The US Commerce Department signed a letter of intent for a $300M CHIPS award to GlobalFoundries $GFS for silicon photonics R&D, taking about a 1% equity stake. The money goes to next generation photonics wafer tech, optical materials, and advanced packaging for co-packaged optics, targeting 400Gb/s and a 5x gain in power efficiency.

stories.headline: Chiplet interconnect startup Eliyan closes a $145M Series C at a $1B valuation

key_facts.fact: Eliyan announced on July 29, 2026 that it completed a Series C totaling $145 million at a $1 billion valuation, making it a unicorn.
key_facts.excerpt: Santa Clara, Calif. – July 29, 2026 – Eliyan Corporation … today announced it has completed its Series C with a total of $145 million at a $1 billion valuation.

key_facts.fact: The oversubscribed round was led by Seligman Ventures with two new strategic investors, Cisco Investments and Lumentum; Seligman managing partner Umesh Padval joins the board.
key_facts.excerpt: The oversubscribed round was led by Seligman Ventures, with participation from additional new and existing investors, including two new strategic investors: Cisco Investments and Lumentum. … Umesh Padval, Managing Partner of Seligman Ventures, will join Eliyan's Board of Directors.

key_facts.fact: Eliyan builds Die-to-Die, Chip-to-Chip and Rack-to-Rack chiplet interconnect technology, and the funding is meant to push it into the electro-optical interconnect market.
key_facts.excerpt: The funding positions the company to expand into the rapidly growing electro-optical interconnect technology market. … Eliyan's Die-to-Die, Chip-to-Chip, and Rack-to-Rack chiplet interconnect technologies are designed to address the increasingly complex connectivity demands of next-generation AI systems

key_facts.fact: The company aims to license the technology and make physical chiplets to ease AI chip data transfer bottlenecks.
key_facts.excerpt: Eliyan, which aims to license tech and make physical "chiplets" to ease AI chip data transfer bottlenecks, raised a $145M Series C at a $1B valuation

key_facts.fact: Days earlier, on July 24, Eliyan unveiled NuLink-XD, a 224G PAM4 SerDes built on TSMC's 3nm process that it says cuts power by up to 40% for chip-to-chip and chip-to-module links.
key_facts.excerpt: SANTA CLARA, California – July 24, 2026 – … Eliyan … today unveiled NuLink™-XD, its new power-reach configurable 224G PAM4 SerDes architecture … Up to 40% lower power … Designed on TSMC 3nm

stories.headline: Qualcomm signs a 10-year deal to be BMW's lead compute silicon supplier

key_facts.fact: Qualcomm said on July 29, 2026 it signed a 10-year deal to supply chips for BMW's future digital cockpit and advanced driver-assistance systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Qualcomm says it has signed a 10-year deal to supply chips for BMW's future digital cockpit and advanced driver-assistance systems

key_facts.fact: CEO Cristiano Amon said BMW selected Qualcomm for next-generation ADAS and automated driving as well as the digital cockpit, for model programs through the next decade, making Qualcomm its lead compute silicon provider.
key_facts.excerpt: BMW Group has selected @Qualcomm for their next-generation ADAS and automated driving systems as well as digital cockpit for model programs through the next decade, establishing Qualcomm as their lead compute silicon provider.

key_facts.fact: Qualcomm said the deal brings its Snapdragon Digital Chassis portfolio to BMW model programs through the next decade.
key_facts.excerpt: A trusted collaboration enters a new era. @BMW Group has selected Qualcomm as its leading compute silicon provider, bringing the @Snapdragon Digital Chassis portfolio to model programs through the next decade.

key_facts.fact: The win lands as Qualcomm pushes beyond handsets; the same day it also announced it had completed its acquisition of AI software company Modular.

stories.headline: ChipAgents raises $60M Series A2 for agentic AI that designs and verifies chips

key_facts.fact: ChipAgents, which uses AI agents to speed up chip design, raised a $60 million Series A2 led by B Capital, announced July 29, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: ChipAgents, which uses AI agents to help speed up the process of chip design, raised a $60M Series A2 led by B Capital, bringing the expanded round to $134M

key_facts.fact: Founder William Wang said the round brings total Series A funding to $131 million, with Bessemer Venture Partners, Micron Technology, Ericsson and ScOp Venture Capital doubling down.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, ChipAgents is thrilled to announce its 60M Series A2 round led by B Capital, with Bessemer Venture Partners, Micron Technology, Ericsson, ScOp Venture Capital and existing investors doubling down. This brings our total Series A funding to 131M.

key_facts.fact: Annual recurring revenue grew 6x in the first half of 2026 since the $50M Series A1, with more than 120 deployments at semiconductor companies.
key_facts.excerpt: Our annual recurring revenue (ARR) went up 6x in the first half of 2026 since our 50M Series A1 round, and we have more than 120 deployments at semiconductor companies, as one of the industry's largest commercial deployments of agentic AI for chip design and verification.

key_facts.fact: The round came about six months after the initial Series A close and accompanied an expanded partnership with Nvidia.
key_facts.excerpt: ChipAgents announced a $60 million Series A2 funding round, bringing its total Series A financing to $134 million. The chip design software company also expanded its partnership with $NVDA … just six months after its initial Series A close.
